source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Board A of the Singles Event Companion is for Take and Hold against Reconnaissance. The Take and Hold player plays Purge and Secure and the Reconnaissance player plays Reconnaissance Sweep. The app pairs this board with the Tipping Point deployment. Neither disposition fixes the Attacker or Defender role; a roll-off settles that. Every zone, territory, objective and terrain position comes only from the official board image, and this entry states no measurements. Its lettered terrain pieces refer to the parts of the Battlefields: Armageddon kit.
